notes.title: Weeny Wise Release Date Revealed at the BIG Fall Showcase
notes.notes:
During the BIG Fall Showcase, the release date trailer for Weeny Wise was officially unveiled, and we’re excited to announce that we’ll be joining you and your companion on February 18, 2026!


[previewyoutube="z2Zc0DTDW1o;full"][/previewyoutube]
It’s been a full year since our last trailer, and during that time we’ve been working hard, learning, experimenting, and implementing bold new ideas! all with one goal in mind: to create a truly unforgettable co-op adventure.


This journey hasn’t been easy, but your support and enthusiasm mean everything to us. That’s why we’d love for you to keep cheering us on, so we can continue building Weeny Wise with even more passion and determination🍄💖


We sincerely hope you’ll enjoy the new trailer, and we can’t wait to share even more exciting updates with you in the coming months.



Mark your calendars for February 18, 2026, and get ready to step into the magical world of Weeny Wise with your companion by your side.
